The '''Nar Shaddaa spaceport''' was a [[spaceport]] located on the<ref name="Bounty Hunters 15" /> [[Smuggler]]'s [[Moon]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters 14">[[Bounty Hunters 14|''Bounty Hunters'' 14]]</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters 15" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of [[Bounty Hunters 15|''Bounty Hunters'' 15]] take place during ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of to [[3 ABY]].</ref> the [[bounty hunter]]s [[Beilert Valance]] and [[Dengar]] visited the spaceport and boarded a [[Star Commuter 2000]] [[shuttle]] to [[Canto Bight]] as they attempted to keep a low profile whilst they were hunted by the [[Crimson Dawn]] [[assassin]] [[Deathstick]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters 15" />
